 Tobey Maguire, Jonah Hill, and Orlando Bloom shared the room with Ice Spice, Cara Delevingne, Elizabeth Banks, and 50 Cent were some of the guests

 Leonardo DiCaprio's 52nd birthday has turned a private residence in Los Angeles into the meeting point for half of Hollywood to celebrate such an important date for the artist and, as usually happens, he is doing it in style. 
 Tobey Maguire, Jonah Hill and Orlando Bloom shared the room with Ice Spice, Cara Delevingne, Elizabeth Banks and 50 Cent were some of the guests  at this event... but it did not stop there, since it also featured the presence of George DiCaprio, the honoree's father, and it is speculated that Al Pacino was also there with Noor Alfallah. 
 Leonardo DiCaprio stunning renovations to his sprawling Malibu mansion On top of all that, the party also had the icing on the cake with the arrival of a minibus loaded with young people, apparently, participants in the reality show Love Island. One of the most prominent from the show was  Courtney Boerner, who has 300,000 followers and has already walked the most important red carpets in cinema.
 Alongside all this, Jeff Bezos was also present. The founder of Amazon and the actor have maintained a public relationship for years.
 DiCaprio, his relationship and his past with those under 25
 DiCaprio's love life has always been intense. He has now been in a romantic relationship for several years with the Italian model Vittoria Ceretti, 28 years old.  
 The actor's romantic pattern has been the subject of viral comments on the internet for years due to a very marked statistical trend: the vast majority of his partners have been young models under the age of 25 .
